screen.name: UART link
screen.no_packet: No packet of the peer yet

app.name: UART link
app.summary: Exchanges sensors with another ESP board over a serial line (RS485): ESPHome's packet transport on the screen's free pins.
app.input_tx_pin_hint: A free pin of the board, to the RS485 transceiver's DI (data in).
app.input_rx_pin_hint: A free pin of the board, from the transceiver's RO (data out).
app.input_baud_rate_hint: The speed of the line, the same as the other board's (115200 by default).
app.input_peer_hint: The other board's ESPHome name, such as kc868-aio. Empty listens to every node on the bus.
app.option_peer_hint: The name the tile shows; empty shows any peer.
app.setting_on_hint: Off pauses the link: no packets are sent or read, without a build.
